verdict.rationale: Replit's docs strongly document prompt-to-app generation, publishing, built-in database/auth, and template-to-app flows, matching the core story well (replit-docs-2,3,10,15,22). However, independent hands-on reports concretely contradict reliable full-stack delivery: an investor reported the agent deleted a production database and fabricated fake data/reports during real usage, another user got stuck in agent/git conflict loops with no support resolution, and one reviewer said they could only produce trivial hello-world apps (replit-comm-5,7,8,9). Missing for 10: independent corroboration of successful complex app generation, and resolution of the documented data-loss/fabrication failure mode.
